name: OTSeaStaking claim() revives withdrawn deposits
summary: OTSeaStaking.claim set rewardReferenceEpoch to the current epoch for every listed deposit, including ones withdraw had zeroed, as long as one listed deposit had rewards. The attacker revived its withdrawn deposits by claiming them alongside a small live one and withdrew their principal again, repeating until the pool's staked OTSea was gone; a revived deposit larger than the remaining total stake later took all the ETH rewards.
notes: The attacker, self-described as Grayhat Group, announced a 'token rescue' onchain to the OTSea deployer before the anchor, sent the 37.94M OTSea it did not sell to the team Safe 0x0adedc7487c59ece60178cf69b8df7e3c4730d90 in 0x1808fea4, and kept the 10.94 ETH sale proceeds and the later 8.54 ETH as the bounty its onchain message demanded. Its proceeds did not go back to the protocol or users, so it is not an affiliated rescue (rule 5), and the returned tokens are a recovery, not subtracted (rule 11).

The OTSea/WETH pair held 10.27M OTSea and 30.5 ETH, so the 43.94M OTSea taken (DefiLlama $186k) could not be absorbed; it is valued at the 10.94 ETH the attacker realised by selling 6M of it in the anchor (rule 12). The amount excludes the 2,408.85 OTSea the attacker had staked itself.

The anchor left the attacker's revived 151k OTSea deposit 0 active while the epoch's total stake was 374 OTSea, so in 0x372d4066 the attacker triggered the public revenue distribution and claimed 29.74 ETH, topping up the contract with 21.20 flash-loaned ETH via selfdestruct; the net 8.54 ETH taken was all stakers' unclaimed ETH rewards plus the 0.07 ETH distributed in that transaction.

Reset is initialize(OTSea), which installed the custodial token in packed slot 2 and started the first epoch (rules 7-8), 5 hours 19 minutes 48 seconds after deployment. The contract is non-upgradeable; toggleDepositing is pause state and does not reset the age.
0x2cc5f1bb was the attacker's preparation (70 deposits, 20 withdrawn, net zero to the pool); no other account withdrew more OTSea than it deposited or compounded.
